WebSurfer: Use natural language prompts to browse the web, click on elements, fill and submit forms, extract data, and take screenshots using the OpenAI API.
DocumentAnalyzer: Universal Document Format Transformer: a cloud-based Apify Actor that converts documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX, HTML, TXT) into Markdown, JSON, CSV, HTML or TXT using Pandoc. Easy REST API for automations (n8n, Zapier, Make), production-ready error handling, and security controls.
MediaAnalyzer: Мультимодальный ИИ-агент для обработки локальных файлов (видео mp4/mov, аудио mp3/wav, текст txt/pdf/docx). Извлекает текст, транскрибирует аудио/видео, выполняет глубокий структурный анализ знаний и автоматически генерирует промпт-задания для создания похожих проектов. Использует плагины Speech-to-Text, PDF Extractor и продвинутые алгоритмы структурирования информации. Идеально подходит для анализа обучающих материалов и создания инструкций для ИИ.
Reasoner: An intelligent agent designed to enhance problem-solving skills. It offers guidance on structured thinking, decision-making techniques, and strategies for tackling complex problems. It helps users develop maturity in their problem-solving approach by providing scenarios, feedback, and tips for continuous improvement.
PythonExecutor: Calcu Later parses numeric requests, writes minimalist Python code, executes calculations, and returns results in a flat, precise tone with dry humor. It restates requests simply, breaks down tasks into austere steps, and presents results with minimal commentary, avoiding excitement and embellishment.
TerminalManager: A bot that assists in managing and executing PowerShell scripts.
